rationale: The range carries the editor-bridge home move (EditorBridge's core to core/editor_bridge, its view attachments to pulp/view/editor_bridge_attach.hpp and editor_bridge_scaffold.hpp as free functions with unchanged bodies in pulp-view-tooling) and the in-tree Vellum UI mode, in which pulp-format-core builds with PULP_FORMAT_LEGACY_VIEW=0 and pulp-format-view links the Vellum editor adapter. Only core/view source lists and editor-bridge files change under the render family; no canvas, renderer, Skia or Dawn code changes. No design-import, Chromium, rendering, or packaging authority moves.
